svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-08-06
svg.desc: Numeric monster debug spawning and structured documentation folders.
svg.text: 2026-08-06 - Debug spawning and documentation structure
main | commits 4c15782, 57fe4b6 | manually reconstructed daily mind map
Daily job
Make debug spawning table-driven and make documentation intent visible.
7 changed runtime/config/doc files for numeric spawning; 10 changed or renamed documentation paths for organization.
BEFORE
Debug and docs friction
String IDs in MonsterSpawnTable
no direct numeric spawn command
spawn ownership was harder to trace
Docs were flat and did not signal whether
a file was a plan, report, or reference.
re-route through authority
AFTER
Numeric, authoritative, discoverable
IDs 1-6 load as int32 rows; GameMode resolves and spawns the selected row.
AddMonster routes CheatManager -> PlayerController -> server RPC -> GameMode.
The row keeps level, class, scale, and respawn data; only location is overridden.
Docs are grouped into Plans, Reference, Reports, and Tracking with Docs/README.md.
Affected paths: MonsterSpawnTable.json, AuraGameModeBase, AuraPlayerController, AuraCheatManager.
Important guard
Only the authoritative GameMode creates the enemy.
Client requests are forwarded; invalid pawn, GameMode,
table, or row conditions report failure instead of spawning.
Debug ID is a lookup contract, not the gameplay source of truth.
Validation and reading path
Commits reviewed: 4c15782 and 57fe4b6.
Read runtime spawn changes with the config row;
read documentation moves through Docs/README.md.
Newcomer result: fast test spawning, clear ownership, clear doc intent.
